findings.claim: The packed verification report is mislabeled as task 3 even when it is the task-5 clean gate receipt.
findings.evidence: The verifier writes `task: 3` in the generated report object, while the retained clean-gate evidence is `task-5-verification.json` and `task-5-clean-gates.md` describes the clean packed production boundary.
findings.suggested_fix: Set the report metadata to the actual verification task, or make the task number an explicit argument/default matching the task-5 clean gate.

findings.claim: Scoped stores attach focus/reconnect listeners but the garbage collector still starts without being bound to the scoped store.
findings.evidence: The diff changes `runGarbageCollection(storeApi: GraphStore = graphStore)` and `attachGlobalListeners(storeApi: GraphStore = graphStore)`, but `attachGlobalListeners` still calls `restartGarbageCollector()` without passing `storeApi`, so the defaulted GC path can continue to operate on `graphStore` rather than the provider-owned graph.
findings.suggested_fix: Thread the selected `GraphStore` through the garbage-collector registration, or explicitly document and test that GC is intentionally singleton-only and not part of the scoped engine contract.
